summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Everbright Digital Holding Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting a routine board change. The filing discloses the resignation of Ms. Chan Po Yu as a director effective March 6, 2026, and the appointment of Mr. Gong Yushan as an independent director on April 13, 2026, to fill the vacancy. Mr. Gong was also appointed to the Audit and Compensation Committees. No terms such as price, premium, or deal value are involved. There is no indication of disagreement or special-situation event. This is a standard corporate governance disclosure under Rule 13a-16, equivalent to a U.S. Form 8-K reporting a director change. It does not constitute a special situation.
